title: Czechia: Czech Coalition Fractures Over Deficit Cuts · 18 Sep
keywords: Czechia, Czech budget 2027, deficit reduction, coalition dispute, Andrej Babiš, Agrofert, EU subsidies, European Commission, conflict of interest, Czech National Bank, inflation, fiscal policy, rule of law, EU funds, Czech politics
notes: Czechia faces a twin political stress test as a coalition dispute over the 2027 budget threatens to deepen divisions within the government, while the European Commission has withheld millions in subsidy reimbursements over unresolved conflict-of-interest concerns linked to former prime minister Andrej Babiš and his Agrofert conglomerate. Both crises reflect a country grappling with fiscal discipline and rule-of-law accountability simultaneously. Together, they are shaping public trust in institutions at a moment when Czech citizens are already fatigued by years of economic turbulence and political friction.
